messages:
Maya (People Ops): @channel :wave: Quick heads-up — PDX Community Day on Tue May 12. Plan: 9–12 deep work (quiet floors), 12:30–2 lunch + Laurel Heights garden volunteer (optional), 2–4 workshops. Please RSVP (short form): https://tinyurl.com/pdx-cd-rsvp

Sam (Facilities): Accessible parking will be reserved in Visitor Lot A. Main elevator will remain in service. If you need a mobility-aid storage spot, DM me. :wheelchair:

Arjun: Do the shuttles stop near Beaverton? I'm driving from Hillsboro, could I get the travel stipend? :car:

Maya (People Ops): Shuttle runs we're scheduling (tentative):
```
08:30 | PDX Central Station (south exit)
08:50 | Lloyd Center Transit Center
09:10 | Office (arrival)
```
Stipend: $25 reimbursement for commutes >20 miles (submit via expenses). If you need a pickup from Beaverton/closer suburbs, mark "need ride" on the RSVP and we'll try to fold you into a route. If you're carpooling, check the carpool box so we can prioritize spots.

Lena: :seedling: I'll bring extra garden gloves and a small first-aid kit. Anyone allergic to bees or with special tool restrictions? We should label any shared gear.

Sam (Facilities): :thumbsup: Confirming volunteer coordinator will provide hypoallergenic snack boxes (gluten-free, nut-free, vegan). We'll also mark a low-scent zone for the deep-work rooms.

Arjun: Thanks. Will there be quiet workspace after lunch? I want to stay on my deep-work schedule and not join a workshop.

Maya (People Ops): Yes — quiet rooms reserved 1–4pm on Floor 5. If you want a desk near a window or a specific room, put it in the RSVP notes and we'll hold it.

DevBot: calendar-bot created event: "PDX Community Day — People Ops" on May 12, 09:00–16:00 (rooms: Floor5-QuietRooms, Garden).

Nia (Security): Heads-up: temporary van drop-off permitted on SE 3rd for shuttle pickup. Security will staff 8:15–9:30 and help folks with accessibility loading.

Lena: :raised_hands: RSVP'd. I can lead a 25–30min lunchtime mindfulness session if people are interested.

Maya (People Ops): Awesome — adding mindfulness to the schedule. Final RSVP deadline: Friday EOD. Any other requests (dietary, accessibility, parking) DM me or reply here. Thanks everyone! :heart:
